gap: No result ChatGPT got states a cost per metre for cables that do both 240 W and 40 Gbps. I could only work it out for one current-generation cable: the Belkin Connect Thunderbolt 5 (INZ005) at $53.99 per metre from Belkin's own store.
standout_why: I couldn't open the cited rival pages (plugable.com/products/usb4-240w-1m and tbt4-240w-1m) because they returned HTTP 429 on three tries, so I compared against ChatGPT's answer and its saved result list. ChatGPT already showed prices with lengths ($25.95 for 1 m, $34.95 for 1 m, $39.99 for 2 m). Dividing price by length is trivial for any reader, so a cost-per-metre figure adds very little. The longer Cable Matters cable, which could have made a per-metre comparison useful, has no price I could source from an opened page.
decides: It doesn't change the pick. The one figure I sourced, Belkin TB5 at $53.99 per metre, only confirms that an 80 Gbps Thunderbolt 5 cable costs more per metre than the 40 Gbps USB4 and Thunderbolt 4 cables ChatGPT showed. I couldn't source the 1 m versus 2 m per-metre comparison from maker pages, so it shouldn't decide anything.

findings.label: Price at the maker's US store
findings.note: SKU INZ005fq1MBK. Only one variant is listed: 1 m (3.3 ft).

findings.label: Cost per metre for a cable that does both 240 W and 40+ Gbps
findings.note: $53.99 / 1 m = $53.99/m. The page states 'Up to 80Gbps, or 120Gbps with Bandwidth Boost' and 'Up to 240W Power Delivery'. It does not say whether the cable is active or passive.

findings.label: Warranty and certification
findings.value: 2-year warranty; 'Thunderbolt 5 and Intel certified'; e-marker chip
findings.note: Wording quoted from the Belkin product page.

unsourced: Plugable USB4-240W-1M and TBT4-240W-1M prices at plugable.com: three tries each returned HTTP 429. The B&H listing returned 403 and the Best Buy listing timed out. So I have no $/m for Plugable.

Cable Matters USB4 240W 2 m (201304-BLK-2M) price and specs: I found no cablematters.com product page by search. The SHI reseller page (which lists a $21.99 MSRP) returned 403 and the Newegg listing returned 403, so I have no $/m for the 2 m cable.
StarTech 1M-40G-USB4-CABLE: startech.com shows no price or power rating in its page text, and the datasheet PDF is image-only, so I couldn't read its power rating or length from it.
UGREEN USB4 240W 1 m price at us.ugreen.com: HTTP 429 twice.
Apple Thunderbolt 5 Pro Cable price: the apple.com URL I tried was a search results page with no product data.
OWC Thunderbolt 5 cable price at owc.com: the URL I guessed returned 404.
I didn't try Anker Prime Thunderbolt 5 or Monoprice #44117 because I hit the tool-call budget.
Passive versus active construction and the longest length that does both 240 W and 40 Gbps per candidate: no maker page I opened states it.
The storecheck.py and amzcheck.py tools and curl were blocked by permission prompts in this session, so I couldn't use them to get Shopify or Amazon prices.
